title: More Is Not More: What Matters for Opinion Diversity in LLM Simulations?
abstract: arXiv:2607.20429v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Large language models are increasingly used to simulate diverse human opinions in open-ended tasks such as synthetic surveys, focus group modeling, and public opinion prediction. However, LLM outputs exhibit systematic opinion homogenization, and a simulation cannot reproduce a population's opinion distribution without first covering its range of viewpoints. Interventions to increase diversity are evaluated in isolation with incomparable metrics and are typically deployed and upgraded simultaneously, making it difficult to attribute gains to specific components. We design a factorial experiment that separates two primary intervention dimensions: input conditioning (operationalized through persona depth) and interaction architecture. translated_title: 多多未必益善：什么因素才对大语言模型模拟中的观点多样性至关重要？
translated_abstract: 大语言模型越来越多地被用于在开放式任务（如合成调查、焦点小组建模和公众舆论预测）中模拟多样的人类观点。然而，大语言模型的输出表现出系统性的观点同质化，而如果模拟不能首先覆盖一个群体的观点范围，就无法再现该群体的观点分布。用于提升多样性的干预措施通常被孤立地评估、使用不可比较的指标，并且往往被同时部署和升级，这使得难以将效果提升归因于具体的组件。我们设计了一个因子实验，将两个主要的干预维度分离开来：输入条件化（通过人格深度来操作化）和交互架构。我们在7个模型上，使用多种互补的多样性指标，对100个真实用户的开放式问题评估了所有条件。我们的发现挑战了若干常见的假设。首先，m……（原文摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 该论文设计因子实验将人格深度（输入条件化）与交互架构两个干预维度解耦，在7个模型、100个真实用户问题上验证了“更多并不等于更好”，从而挑战了提升大语言模型模拟观点多样性的常见假设。
en_tdlr: This paper designs a factorial experiment that disentangles input conditioning (persona depth) from interaction architecture, and across 7 models and 100 real-user open-ended questions shows that "more is not more" when it comes to opinion diversity in LLM simulations, challenging several common assumptions.
